newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan shares fall to all-time low.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan shares fall to all-time low.

text.p: Shares in Yaohan Japan Corp slipped to their lowest level ever on Friday.
Brokers said the retailer, which has been on a recent downtrend, was further hit by a Japanese rating agency's downgrading on Thursday.
The share price was down 60 yen at 303 yen at 0133 GMT, below its previous record low of 350 yen marked on Thursday. Volume was 4.65 million shares.
On Thursday, Japan Credit Rating Agency Ltd said that it would downgrade four legs of Yaohan Japan's convertible bonds, totalling 50 billion yen, to "B-" from "BB+".
Brokers said the rating agency's announcement prompted loss-cutting sales in Yaohan's shares.
